item.description: The revelation stems from a data-sharing agreement signed last April.

item.description: Marimar Martinez was shot five times by a Border Patrol agent in October while in her vehicle.

item.title: CT man arrested for allegedly threatening to ‘blow up’ elementary school
item.description: Police said the Fairfield County Regional Dispatch Center received a text to 911 that allegedly read, “I’ll blow up Coleytown Elementary School.”

item.title: Member of Trump’s Religious Liberty Commission ousted in dispute over antisemitism
item.description: The ousted member, Carrie Prejean Boller, had defended commentator Candace Owens.

item.title: UConn women’s basketball smothers Creighton in second half to earn largest win in series history
item.description: The UConn women's basketball team smothered Creighton in the second half to earn its largest win in series history on Wednesday night.

item.title: UConn men surge past Butler late for a 80-70 win behind Ball’s six 3-pointers
item.description: UConn junior Solo Ball made six 3-pointers and Braylon Mullins scored 15 points in his homecoming as the Huskies got back on track with a win at Butler.
